architecture: Bounded Authority Plane (BAP) Control Channel & Network Matrix (BAP-912)

channels.name: HookWatch to Edge Agent Runtime
channels.authentication: Process Parent Ancestry Verification & Workspace Path Anchor
channels.purpose: Intercept in-harness agent lifecycle events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd)
channels.failure_behavior: fail-closed (tool execution blocked if hook adapter fails or bapedge unreachable)
channels.revocation_behavior: immediate-kill (bapedge returns deny envelope halting tool execution)
channels.restart_behavior: re-attest-session (adapter executes EnsureSessionStarted on next event)

channels.name: Edge Agent Runtime to Control Plane API
channels.authentication: Workstation Session Token / Bearer JWT / X-BAP-Admin-Token
channels.encryption: TLS 1.3 with AES-256-GCM / SHA-256 Certificate Pinning
channels.purpose: Workstation registration, session enrollment, policy bundle synchronization, and heartbeats
channels.failure_behavior: fail-safe-cached (falls back to signed local Cedar bundle within 15-min offline grace period; high-risk actions fail closed)
channels.revocation_behavior: sse-disconnect (revocation broadcast invalidates local session and triggers endpoint freeze)

channels.name: Control Plane Policy Stream to Edge Runtime
channels.authentication: Attested Workstation SPIFFE SVID & JWS Signature Verification
channels.encryption: TLS 1.3 + RFC 7515 JWS Compact Signed Bundle Payload
channels.purpose: Real-time policy bundle streaming, dynamic hot-reloading, and instant revocation propagation
channels.failure_behavior: fail-safe-cached (maintains in-memory verified policy; buffers pending events)
channels.revocation_behavior: immediate-push (sub-second kill-switch and session stop propagation)
channels.restart_behavior: auto-reconnect-backoff (exponential backoff with jitter up to 30s)

channels.name: Edge Agent Runtime to SPIFFE / STS Token Service
channels.purpose: Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) ephemeral credential issuance, monotonic scope attenuation, and On-Behalf-Of (OBO) token exchange
channels.failure_behavior: fail-closed (zero target credentials issued; agent execution halted)
channels.revocation_behavior: token-burn (single-use grants atomically burned via BurnGrantOnce; subsequent calls rejected)
channels.restart_behavior: re-attest-session (agent must present valid session liveness token to mint new credential)

channels.name: Control Plane to Enterprise Identity Provider
channels.destination: Enterprise IdP (Microsoft Entra ID / Okta / GitHub OIDC)
channels.protocol: HTTPS / RFC 8628 OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization / OpenID Connect
channels.authentication: OAuth2 Client Credentials / Public Device Flow with PKCE
channels.purpose: Human operator identity verification, corporate directory group resolution, and OTC device login
channels.failure_behavior: fail-closed (new workstation enrollment blocked; existing attested sessions honor valid TTL)
channels.revocation_behavior: idp-webhook-logout (central user logout revokes all downstream agent sessions)

channels.name: Control Plane to Downstream Target Services (STS Broker)
channels.destination: Downstream SaaS Services (GitHub API, AWS STS, JIRA API)
channels.protocol: HTTPS / REST API / ID-JAG Token Exchange
channels.authentication: Encrypted Enterprise Broker Service Principal / App Installation Token
channels.purpose: Exchange enterprise trust assertion for short-lived (5-min TTL) downstream target access tokens
channels.failure_behavior: fail-closed (no target access granted without verifiable downstream authority)
channels.revocation_behavior: upstream-token-revoke (downstream token revoked at provider API)
channels.restart_behavior: mint-new-grant (ephemeral grant re-requested under active session context)

channels.name: Edge Execution Broker to Local Workspace / Kernel Sandbox
channels.destination: Target Child Tool Process / OS Kernel Sandbox
channels.protocol: OS Native Process Spawning (Windows Job Object / Restricted Token / Landlock LSM)
channels.authentication: Local Process Supervision with SID Filtering & Cryptographic Receipt Generation
channels.purpose: Run permitted agent commands in containment sandbox, scrub ambient credentials, and capture stdout/stderr
channels.failure_behavior: fail-closed (unauthorized commands denied prior to process fork; forbidden escapes terminated)
channels.revocation_behavior: kill-process-tree (terminates broker, child process, and all spawned sub-processes)
channels.restart_behavior: re-evaluate-policy (subsequent commands undergo fresh Cedar evaluation)

channels.name: Administrative Cockpit to Control Plane API
channels.source: Agent Watch Cockpit UI (Browser / Dashboard / Inspector)
channels.authentication: X-BAP-Admin-Token / Session Cookie / Same-Origin CORS Governance
channels.purpose: Executive visibility, live topology inspection, audit search, policy simulation, and emergency freeze controls
channels.failure_behavior: fail-closed (mutation requests rejected without cryptographic admin authentication)
channels.revocation_behavior: immediate-session-freeze (operator freezes compromised agent sessions fleet-wide)
